services.name: agentgateway-init
command: mkdir -p /config; if [ ! -f /config/config.yaml ]; then echo '' | base64 -d > /config/config.yaml; fi; if [ "${MCP_GRAFANA_ENABLED}" = "true" ] && ! grep -q '^  - name: grafana$' /config/config.yaml; then echo '' | base64 -d >> /config/config.yaml; fi; if [ "${MCP_TAILSCALE_ENABLED}" = "true" ] && ! grep -q '^  - name: tailscale$' /config/config.yaml; then echo '' | base64 -d >> /config/config.yaml; fi; chown -R 65532:65532 /config; touch /tmp/ready; while :; do sleep 3600; done

services.name: mcp-grafana
entrypoint: if [ "${MCP_GRAFANA_ENABLED}" != "true" ]; then echo 'Grafana MCP sidecar disabled'; while :; do sleep 3600; done; fi; exec /app/mcp-grafana --transport streamable-http --address 127.0.0.1:8000

services.name: mcp-tailscale
entrypoint: if [ "${MCP_TAILSCALE_ENABLED}" != "true" ]; then echo 'Tailscale MCP sidecar disabled'; while :; do sleep 3600; done; fi; exec bun dist/index.js --http --host 127.0.0.1 --port 3000
